# dokku_app_checks (Resource)

Enables or disables zero-downtime deployment checks for a Dokku app (`dokku checks:enable <app>` / `dokku checks:disable <app>`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether zero-downtime deployment checks are enabled for this app. `true` runs `dokku checks:enable`, `false` runs `dokku checks:disable`, both across all process types.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
